text.en:
The first sentence, section one, of Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred and seventy-four,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Pending approval of the General Appropriation Act for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and
forty-six, Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred and fifty-four, Administrative Order Numbered Five,
dated May twenty-five, nineteen hundred and forty-five, and Executive Order Numbered Eighteen-W, dated
August thirty-first, nineteen hundred and forty-four, shall continue in force for the operation of the
Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines for a period of three months beginning July first,
nineteen hundred and forty-five, and for this purpose, there are hereby appropriated from any fund in the
National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sums equal to one-fourth of the various items of
appropriations authorized in said Act and Administrative and executive orders."

This Act shall take effect on July first, nineteen hundred and forty-five.
Approved, September 18, 1945.
